text:
sam: Heads-up — FRA forwarder put our H100 top-off shipment on hold, says missing commercial invoice and customs flagged SKU mismatch. can vendor confirm?
lauren: Ugh. Which AWB? we have edge clusters waiting on those 8 units.
ev an-forwarder: hi team, AWB 123-45678901 is currently at FRA customs hold. We requested commercial invoice from vendor on 2026-03-21. Customs raised HS code mismatch (8471 vs 8542).
sam: thanks. config: these are replacement RMAs (not new value-add sales) — can we mark as "repair/return" to avoid duties?
ev an-forwarder: customs will accept repair notation but need supplier signed declaration + original PO reference. without that they'll invoice duties.
max: vendor side: i pinged supply@vendorco — they're prepping a stamped invoice but asked if we can accept split AWB (send 4 now, 4 after paperwork) to unblock half. Thoughts?
kai: prefer split if it gets staging units to dca quickly. partial arrival avoids cluster starvation. we can route 4 to FRA -> AMS crossdock, then local courier to DC.
lauren: cost tradeoff? vendor will charge split-handling + extra AWB fee. how much?
max: vendorco quoted €380 extra + €60 per AWB admin. ops-bot: New cost event logged: tag=procurement.extra-shipping amount=€380 reason=split_awb (1715550300) :memo: keep receipts.
ekan-forwarder: we can attempt manual clearance for 4 with a supplier letter + serial manifest. Need final list of serials and PO.
sam: serials below. please attach vendor signed declaration and copy of original PO to customs docs.
```
SN-HT-00123
SN-HT-00124
SN-HT-00125
SN-HT-00126
SN-HT-00127
SN-HT-00128
SN-HT-00129
SN-HT-00130
```
lauren: vendor, can you add "return/replacement under warranty" and quote waiver for duties? we can't absorb 100% of duty on RMA.
ev an-forwarder: i'll escalate with customs broker. If vendor provides warranty declaration + original PO we can apply repair code, otherwise duties apply. estimated clearance window if docs complete: 18-36 hrs.
max: vendorco said they can sign and send within 2 business hours. they asked whether we want a single consolidated AWB or go split — they'll accept our call.
kai: proceed with split AWB for immediate 4 release. continue full docs for remaining 4. schedule local pickup to DC after clearance.
sam: agreed. max, confirm vendor will cover half of split AWB admin (€60) as concession and confirm by EOD. Also need RMA labels attached to each unit for inventory trace.
max: asked vendor to cover €30 (split) and they'll cover rest if paperwork delay cause. awaiting their final.
ev an-forwarder: note — if vendor does not sign, customs may force re-export. will keep channel updated.
lauren: once 4 arrive, ops team will stage and tag as reserved for RMA. kai please prep a hotpath to swap into edge pools.
kai: on it. need ETA to schedule maintenance window. evan-forwarder: estimated pickup-clearance+delivery ETA for first 4: 28-34 hours from now (1715550000 + 100800). will update if vendor docs arrive sooner.
sam: perfect. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
